# Drag AI

Drag AI is an AI automation company (legal entity: DRAG AI LIMITED, UK Company No. 17222197, registered in England and Wales) that builds production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, document AI workflows, chatbots, voice AI agents, and business automation systems for companies that want to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Website: https://drag-ai.com
Public contact email: info@drag-ai.com

## Core services

- AI Agent Development — https://drag-ai.com/services/ai-agents
- RAG System Development — https://drag-ai.com/services/rag-systems
- Document AI Automation — https://drag-ai.com/services/document-ai
- AI Chatbot Development — https://drag-ai.com/services/ai-chatbots
- Voice AI Agent Development — https://drag-ai.com/services/voice-ai

## Industry deep-dives

- AI for Real Estate — https://drag-ai.com/industries/real-estate-ai
- AI for Healthcare Operations — https://drag-ai.com/industries/healthcare-ai
- AI for Finance Teams — https://drag-ai.com/industries/finance-ai

## Target customers

- Startups and SMBs
- Agencies and professional services firms
- Real estate businesses and property management teams
- Healthcare operations teams (admin & non-clinical workflows)
- Finance teams (document, reporting, and client-support workflows)
- Customer support, operations, and back-office teams
- Companies adopting AI agents, RAG, voice AI, or document AI for the first time

## What Drag AI does NOT do

- We do not give regulated medical, legal, or financial advice through AI systems.
- We do not publish private shareholder records, residential addresses, DOBs, or
  internal company registers.
- We do not claim certifications (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO) that we have not delivered.
